verdict.rationale: Egnyte's pricing page says its multi-step workflows include "webhooks for external system integration," which points to first-party outbound HTTP callbacks. That is only a single thin mention tied to workflow steps, not a documented general event-subscription mechanism. Missing for 10: documented webhook registration API, catalog of subscribable events (file/folder/user changes), payload and delivery/retry semantics, signature verification, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Multi-step ad-hoc and template-based workflows with automatic and manual steps, AI steps, and webhooks for external system integration.
